json-web-token.diagram:
flowchart TB
  subgraph T["JWT 구조"]
    H["Header: alg·typ"]
    P["Payload: iss·sub·exp 클레임"]
    S["Signature"]
  end
  H -->|"Base64URL"| E["인코딩된 Header.Payload"]
  P -->|"Base64URL"| E
  E -->|"HS256 비밀키·RS256 개인키"| S
  subgraph V["서버 검증"]
    V1["서명 검증 (alg 고정)"] --> V2["exp·iss·aud 확인"] --> V3["클레임으로 인가"]
  end
  T -->|"Authorization: Bearer"| V
json-web-token.pseudocode:
def sign(header, payload, key):
    h = b64url(to_json(header))
    p = b64url(to_json(payload))
    sig = b64url(hmac_sha256(key, h + '.' + p))
    return h + '.' + p + '.' + sig

def verify(token, key, now):
    h, p, sig = token.split('.')
    header = from_json(b64url_decode(h))
    if header['alg'] != 'HS256':  # none·키 혼동 공격 차단
        return False
    expected = b64url(hmac_sha256(key, h + '.' + p))
    if not const_time_eq(sig, expected):
        return False  # 위변조
    claims = from_json(b64url_decode(p))
    if claims['exp'] <= now:  # 만료 검증
        return False
    return claims['iss'] == TRUSTED_ISSUER  # 발급자 검증
